heard: Timur bore a son to Eliphaz, in the land of Edom he became chief Descended from Esau and Adah, Amalek rose in the desert wild A tribal leader of the old line, rooted in the history of the soil Blood out the memory from under heaven The Lord declared a war for ages Remember what was done along the way Their names shall fade in God's judgment At refitting they attacked from behind Striking the weary and the worn out Moses stood on the hill with the staff Joshua fought with the edge of the sword Aaron and Hur held his hands up Until the sunset brought the victor
